analysis.rationale: Standalone profit after tax surged to Rs. 8,770.55 lakhs from a loss of Rs. 27,234.57 lakhs YoY, with revenue up 22% to Rs. 40,569.07 lakhs. Exceptional items in the prior year (impairment of German subsidiaries) are absent, indicating a strong operational turnaround.
analysis.summary: Borosil Renewables reported strong standalone Q1 FY27 profit of Rs. 8,770.55 lakhs vs loss of Rs. 27,234.57 lakhs in Q1 FY26, driven by revenue growth and absence of exceptional impairment charges.
